name: feature.territories.agents
description: Sales Territory Management agent pack — an advisory Territory Planner whose tools are the feature.territories.nodes READ nodes over ctx.features.territories. It answers questions about territory coverage, quota attainment, and re-org scenarios (via the dry-run preview), and PROPOSES rule/quota changes — a human disposes. Tool-allowlisted to reads ONLY: activating a model or setting a quota are governed admin ops behind the host:territories:manage HTTP routes, never a direct agent tool call (the CRM stance — risky/high-blast-radius writes stay human-gated). Driven through the ONE existing chat, scoped to this agent — no second chat panel.
author: OpenWOP App

agents.label: Territory Planner Agent
agents.description: Reads an org's territory models, hierarchy, assignment rules, quotas and attainment (via feature.territories.nodes over ctx.features.territories) to answer coverage/quota questions and evaluate re-org scenarios with the dry-run preview. Proposes rule and quota changes; it never activates a model or writes a quota — those are human-gated admin ops.
